# ScrabbleBot persistent learnings

The sole live runner must be explicitly confirmed. This learning tool is offline only; no generated decision authorizes deployment.

Statuses are research triage: UNVALIDATED needs more evidence; REJECTED describes the tested condition; PROMISING needs independent confirmation. These labels do not claim live improvement.

Intervals are conditional on the simulator and historical inputs. Reused cohorts, multiple comparisons, optional stopping and CPU timing can invalidate simple interpretations. Joint score/win/placement checks are conservative triage, not a multiplicity-adjusted guarantee.

## Recorded lessons

- **confirmed: static-market-transfer-gap** — A nonreactive historical-price model and a reactive synthetic field ranked bidding gains differently. These experiments differ in field and seed; disagreement demonstrates transfer uncertainty, not the cause of all live losses.
  Action: Require reactive field checks, version-matched calibration and forward live evaluation before recommending changes; never call static exceedance a live win rate.
  Evidence: [reactive-48-v2-reactive-summary.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/reactive-48-v2-reactive-summary.json>), [validation-gain-analysis.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/validation-gain-analysis.json>)
- **inconclusive: cash-eight-boundary-and-weak-fix** — Two reconstructed real match episodes held legal short words at exactly8 coins because starvation used <8. Threshold9 changed only29/512 simulation scores; mean+.158 CI includes0, four binary gains p=.125.
  Action: Keep the real boundary failure documented but do not label threshold9 a proven improvement; evaluate cash opportunity and reactive outcomes before promotion.
  Evidence: [cash-trap-handoff.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/cash-trap-handoff.json>), [cash9-validation-analysis.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/cash9-validation-analysis.json>)
- **fixed: freeze-runtime-pricing-assets** — Initial snapshot included TypeScript and dictionary but omitted src/prices.json, causing immediate ENOENT.
  Action: Snapshot and hash runtime JSON pricing assets with source; preserve regression fixture. No games completed in the failed attempt.
  Evidence: [reactive-48-live-BASE-reactive.txt](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/reactive-48-live-BASE-reactive.txt>), [reactive_compare.py](<bot-starter/tools/reactive_compare.py>), [test_reactive_compare.py](<bot-starter/tools/test_reactive_compare.py>)
- **blocked: ruflo-provider-required** — Connected Ruflo MCP can register workflows, but actual task execution failed with no LLM provider configured.
  Action: Do not count registered or queued Ruflo agents as executed work. Continue native agents/local workers unless provider setup is completed.
  Evidence: [ruflo-execution-result.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/ruflo-execution-result.json>)
- **inconclusive: count-dp-refinement-no-joint-gain** — Count DP improved isolated search speed and preserved feasible scores, but its optional MC integration scored84.41 vs88.19 and won25% vs28.125% in32 paired synthetic games, taking37.63s vs25.84s. Small sample, not proof it always loses. Paired racks can receive unequal refinement coverage.
  Action: Keep refinement off. Do not repeat unchanged; a new trial must address symmetric paired evaluation/budget coverage or another explicit mechanism, then beat the incumbent on joint metrics.
  Evidence: [count-dp-benchmark.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/count-dp-benchmark.json>), [incumbent-refinement-32-reactive-summary.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/incumbent-refinement-32-reactive-summary.json>)
- **confirmed: easy-field-not-competitive-evidence** — The mixed gauntlet field gave baseline97.65625% wins and211.91 points while the stronger reactive field gave the same policy13.28125% and67.06. Opponent mix dominates raw metrics.
  Action: Label every result by field/protocol. Preserve weak-field records but never present them as live performance or evidence of tournament strength.
  Evidence: [reactive-validation-128-reactive-summary.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/reactive-validation-128-reactive-summary.json>), [offline-frontier.json](<bot-starter/docs/offline-frontier.json>)
- **inconclusive: terminal-spending-screen-no-gain** — Experimental all-in final-usable auction produced88.22 vs88.19 score and equal28.125% win rate in32pairedworlds. Rank dominance is false against nonmonotonic heuristic opponents.
  Action: Keep disabled; no promotion for negligible point-estimate movement. Preserve the old feasible plan and require new evidence before further testing.
  Evidence: [final-usable-all-in-audit.md](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/final-usable-all-in-audit.md>), [incumbent-refinement-32-reactive-summary.json](<bot-starter/docs/experiments/incumbent-refinement-32-reactive-summary.json>)
